titulo: What If You Were the Last Person on Earth? (1,000 Years)
premisa: What if you were the last person on Earth? The viewer wakes up alone in America and lives the timeline in second person, with on-screen chapter cards. DAY 1 – THE SILENCE: no traffic noise in Manhattan, your phone says 'No Service' because cell-tower backup batteries die within hours, cars sit frozen mid-street, and the lights blink out block by block. WEEK 1 – THE GRID DIES: without anyone feeding or watching them, power plants trip into automatic shutdown, the whole grid goes dark, and zoo animals push through failing enclosures (a giraffe wanders a highway). MONTH 1 – SURVIVAL: you raid stores, but fresh food rots fast while honey basically never spoils (archaeologists found still-edible honey in Egyptian tombs). You learn to collect rainwater, and pet dogs turn into feral packs. Small breeds don't make it; the big ones hunt together. YEAR 1 – NATURE STRIKES BACK: the NYC subway normally pumps about 13 million gallons of water out every day, and with the pumps dead some tunnels flood within days. Grass splits the asphalt and deer graze in Times Square. YEARS 10–50 – CITIES CRUMBLE: with no one painting the steel, bridges rust and sag, frozen pipes and water crack skyscrapers, and lightning fires burn through blocks with no firefighters. YEAR 1000+ – WHAT'S LEFT OF US: Mount Rushmore's granite erodes about 1 inch every 10,000 years, so your presidents are still staring out. The pyramids still stand, and the bootprints on the Moon, with no wind to erase them, could last millions of years. TWIST: one night, from a rooftop, you see a light on the horizon. It blinks three short, three long, three short. SOS. Someone else is out there. The narration closes on the loop line: 'So… are you really the last person on Earth?'
gancho: What if you woke up tomorrow… and you were the last person on Earth? (Flash of a tiny light blinking in the dark, then cut to silence.)
